meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: Search claude-mem's persistent cross-session memory database. Use when user asks "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?", or needs work from previous sessions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把之前交流时确定的方案和说法直接找回来
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常和AI助手连续协作,却不时忘记上次聊过的结论
copy.tagline_en: Bring back the solution discussed in a previous session with one question
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with an AI assistant across sessions and forget past conclusions

howto.what: 它能搜索 claude-mem 的跨会话记忆库,按「搜索 → 时间线 → 取详情 → 披露原始工具记录」四层流程查找过去的工作。第一步先返回带 ID、时间和标题的结果表,再按需取某几条的完整摘要,最后一步才回放工具原始输入输出。
howto.when: 当你问的是以前的会话而不是当前对话时触发,例如「这个之前修过吗」「上次是怎么解决的」「上周发生了什么」等。

say.text: 搜一下之前关于登录鉴权的记录
say.note: 返回带 ID 的匹配结果表

say.text: 上次数据库迁移失败是怎么解决的?
say.note: 先给结果索引,再取对应摘要

say.text: 看下 #11131 前后的时间线
say.note: 返回该记录前后各若干条上下文

howto.what_en: Adds a layered memory search over claude-mem: search returns an ID index, timeline adds surrounding context, get_observations fetches full summaries, and raw tool I/O is disclosed only last. It answers questions about work done in earlier sessions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about earlier sessions rather than the current chat — "did we already fix this?", "how did we solve X last time?", or what happened last week.

say_en.text: Search past records about login authentication
say_en.note: Returns a matching result table with IDs

say_en.text: How was last week's database migration failure fixed?
say_en.note: Gives the index first, then the summary
Returns items before and after that record
